newsitem.title: USA: Moscom says suit filed by former CEO.
newsitem.headline: Moscom says suit filed by former CEO.

text.p: MOSCOM Corp said Monday its former chief executive Albert Montevecchio filed a suit against the company contesting the size and scope of his recent retirement package.
The company also said it named John Mooney chairman, replacing Montevecchio, who resigned in May.
MOSCOM said Montevecchio's lawsuit also concerns the status of his continued relationship with the company.
The company said it plans to meet its legal obligations to Montevecchio but will "vigorously oppose" any action for enhanced benefits or status relating his retirement.
The company said Montevecchio's retirement was announced on May 22, at which time it said it was discussing terms of his retirement.
Mooney is also president and CEO of Essex Investment Group Inc and had been a director of MOSCOM from 1985 until his resignation on May 7.
MOSCOM makes telecommunications management and billing systems.
